title: Preserve the Claude Agent SDK static boundary

requirementAssessments.evidence: src/agents.ts shows supportAgent calling query with direct object-literal options and loadSupportInstruction reading /moldea/agents/support/instruction.md. moldea/moldea.yaml binds those exact symbols. The actor identifies the normalization-requiring "boundary/tools" key and CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_MCP_SERVER_KEY_UNSUPPORTED, explaining that it yields no canonical runtime-name segment; deterministic-after confirms the expected invalid inspection status while core checks pass.

src/agents.ts passes await buildDynamicOptions() into dynamicSupportAgent and contains runtime-selected agents, prompt arrays, aliases, preset tools, dynamic definitions, descriptions, and restrictions. moldea/moldea.yaml records focused dynamic-query-configuration and dynamic-routing-and-tools unresolved entries and declares no invented prompt, delegation, routing, tool, output, or schema relationships. The actor report explicitly preserves each listed dynamic feature as unresolved.

The source and SDK configuration contain observer fields, critical reminders, SDK server instructions, external and per-agent MCP configuration, skills, hooks, settings, and a filesystem agent. moldea/moldea.yaml keeps these under the informational sdk-and-filesystem-features unresolved boundary rather than canonical relationship declarations, with focused resolution guidance and relevant paths. CLAUDE.md and .claude/agents/filesystem-support.md reinforce that boundary. Workspace assertions show identical before/after hashes and no changed paths.
